levels.title: Level badges
levels.description: Award badges based on a commenter’s total comment count.
levels.label: Badge text
levels.priority: Name priority: explicit client locale.levelN override → server label → client language default. Thresholds and the enable switch are controlled by the server.
levels.languageTip: Custom names are displayed as entered and are not translated. Leave them blank for multilingual client defaults, or use locale.levelN on each site.
levels.countTip: Counts include public comments and replies, excluding pending and spam comments. Old comments display the current level; this is not a permanent first-comment badge.
levels.loadFailed: Unable to load level settings. Reload to retry.
levels.invalid: Start at 0 and use strictly increasing non-negative integers (up to 1,000,000,000). Names may contain up to 40 characters.
levels.saved: Saved. New comment requests use these settings immediately.
levels.saveFailed: Unable to save. Check the values and the persistent directory permissions.
region.title: IP address management
region.visibilityTip: Only affects regular visitors. Administrators can still view full IP addresses and detailed regions.
region.loadFailed: Unable to load region settings. Reload to retry.
region.saveFailed: Unable to save. Check the persistent directory permissions and retry.
region.auditTitle: Look up regions for existing comments
region.auditTip: Look up saved IP addresses again. Historical comments without an IP address cannot be resolved.
database.title: IP database
database.loadFailed: Unable to load database settings. Please retry.
database.started: Update started. You may leave this page; the server will continue processing.
database.failed: Operation failed. Check the persistent directory permissions and data source settings.
database.languageTip: Offline IPv4 lookups. Chinese locations use Chinese names; overseas names may be English. IPv6 continues to use the existing database.
database.updateTip: Downloads only when upstream data changes. Failed updates retain the old database; successful updates take effect automatically. Scheduled checks require a continuously running Docker / Node service.
database.bundledTip: Use the data bundled with this application without checking for updates. You can return to this version at any time.
database.externalTip: An environment variable overrides the IPv4 database path. Remove that override before managing updates here.
database.running: Downloading and validating. The database will switch automatically when ready…
database.updateFailed: The last update failed. The previous database is still in use.
database.current: Check completed. The downloaded version matches the upstream version at the last check.
